title: Dealer registration (BSE)
purpose: Dealers and their BSE terminals (user IDs) to add or modify: one pipe-delimited row of 38 fields per terminal, no header, exactly one newline at the end. Written on Dealers & terminals → Exchange files.

columns.name: Add/Modify
columns.note: A to add, M to modify

columns.name: 14 Digit
columns.note: order type code 0-8 (0 non-algo, 1 algo, 2 algo using SOR, 3 non-algo SOR, 4 inter-exchange algo, 5 RMS square-off, 6 AMO, 7 basket, 8 batch)

columns.name: NatureofOffice
columns.note: code; Ledgerline writes 0 for a branch and 1 for an AP office (to confirm)

columns.name: Relationship
columns.note: code; Ledgerline writes 0 employee, 1 AP, 2 AP employee (to confirm)

columns.name: ActiveTerminal
columns.note: Y active, N inactive, P permanent deletion

columns.name: Cash
columns.note: Y or N; likewise the other segment fields

columns.name: AlGO_NONALGO
columns.note: Y for an algo terminal, N otherwise

columns.name: ID
columns.note: BSE's record ID: blank on add, required on modify (from BSE's download of the records)

linked: Written from the dealers register (Dealers & terminals)
